question: Let $\vec{A} = 3\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}$ and $\vec{B} = 6\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + 8\hat{k}$. Find a unit vector $\vec{n}$ perpendicular to both $\vec{A}$ and $\vec{B}$ and with positive $z$-component, and calculate the area of a triangle with sides $\vec{A}$ and $\vec{B}$ using the cross product.
explanation:
First, $\vec{n}$ is in direction of $\vec{A} \times \vec{B}$.

Compute $\vec{A} \times \vec{B}$:

$\vec{A} \times \vec{B} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & 4 & -5 \\ 6 & -2 & 8 \end{vmatrix}$

$= \hat{i}\left(4 \cdot 8 - (-5) \cdot (-2)\right) - \hat{j}\left(3 \cdot 8 - (-5) \cdot 6\right) + \hat{k}\left(3 \cdot (-2) - 4 \cdot 6\right)$

$= \hat{i}[32 - 10] - \hat{j}[24 + 30] + \hat{k}[-6 - 24]$

$= 22\hat{i} - 54\hat{j} - 30\hat{k}$

But we want positive $z$-component so take $-(22\hat{i} - 54\hat{j} - 30\hat{k}) = -22\hat{i} + 54\hat{j} + 30\hat{k}$

Its magnitude:

$\sqrt{(-22)^2 + 54^2 + 30^2} = \sqrt{484 + 2916 + 900} = \sqrt{4300}$

$= 10\sqrt{43}$

So, unit vector:

$\vec{n} = \dfrac{-22\hat{i} + 54\hat{j} + 30\hat{k}}{10\sqrt{43}}$

Area of triangle:

$\text{Area} = \dfrac{1}{2}|\vec{A} \times \vec{B}| = \dfrac{1}{2} \times 10\sqrt{43} = 5\sqrt{43}$

Final answers:

$\vec{n} = \dfrac{-22\hat{i} + 54\hat{j} + 30\hat{k}}{10\sqrt{43}}$

$\text{Area} = 5\sqrt{43}$
